    B = np.array(data["B"], dtype=int)

    best_cost = None
    best_time = None

        return np.sum(A * B[perm_arr][:, perm_arr])

        perm[i], perm[j] = perm[j], perm[i]
        return perm

        new_perm = perturb(current)
